item.title: Microsoft AI Releases Microsoft-Decision-1: A Qwen3.5-9B Decision-Scoring Model
item.description:
Microsoft has released Microsoft-Decision-1, a decision model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model that returns a calibrated probability for each fixed answer option instead of generated text. It is post-trained from Alibaba’s Qwen3.5-9B and available now in Microsoft Foundry and OpenRouter. . TL;DR What is a decision model? A […]

item.title: Nace AI Open-Sources Drex 1.5: A 9B Decision Model That Scores Options, Not Text
item.description:
Nace.AI has open-sourced Drex 1.5, a 9B decision model that returns a probability for every option in 1 forward pass. It scores 58.08 on Decision Index 0.3.1 and reads up to 128K tokens.

The post Nace AI Open-Sources Drex 1.5: A 9B Decision Model That Scores Options, Not Text appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Alibaba Qwen Releases Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an 8-Step 7B Image Model
item.description:
Alibaba’s Qwen team has released Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an accelerated checkpoint of its open-weight Qwen-Image-2.1 model. It generates and edits images in 8 denoising steps instead of the base model’s 40-step default. For developers, that means 5x fewer denoising steps on the same 7B architecture, plus a hosted API option. TL;DR What is Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo? Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an […]

item.title: OpenAI Decisions API Hits Public Beta With 10x Faster Typed Answers
item.description:
OpenAI’s Decisions API is now in public beta on GPT-6 Luna. It returns typed probabilities, choices and scores about 10x faster than the Responses API, billing $0.10 per 1M input tokens with no output charges.

The post OpenAI Decisions API Hits Public Beta With 10x Faster Typed Answers appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meet the Underdog Saluki 27B: A 2-bit Qwen3.8-27B That Beats the Original at Tool Calling
item.description:
Underdog Saluki 27B is a 7.89 GB, 2-bit GGUF of Qwen3.8-27B under Apache 2.0. It beats the 54 GB original on tool calling but gives up ground on competition math and reasoning.

item.title: JetBrains Releases Mellum2.1: A 12B MoE Open Model for Coding Agents
item.description:
JetBrains released Mellum2.1, an Apache 2.0, 12B mixture-of-experts thinking model with 2.5B active parameters. RL in real repositories lifted its SWE-bench Verified score from 2.0 to 47.0.

item.title: Architect Launches Liquid Inference, a Real-Time Auction for LLM Inference

item.title: NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes
item.description:
NVIDIA researchers introduced PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation method that trains multi-turn LLM agents to avoid early pivotal mistakes and recover from them, posting the best average against 13 baselines on 3 agent benchmarks.
